class.name: SimpleTerrain3D
class.description: [SimpleTerrain3D] renders and edits a [SimpleTerrainData] height field. The node splits terrain geometry into chunks so renderer culling and brush mesh rebuilds can operate on smaller regions. The inherited [member MeshInstance3D.mesh] is kept empty; terrain chunks are submitted as internal [RenderingServer] instances. All methods and properties listed in this class are registered through ClassDB, so they can be used from GDScript, C#, editor tools, and the Inspector. A typical runtime setup creates a [SimpleTerrain3D], adjusts [member grid_size], [member cell_size], and [member chunk_size], then calls [method reset_flat_terrain] or [method generate_random_terrain]. [codeblock] var terrain := SimpleTerrain3D.new() terrain.grid_size = 128 terrain.cell_size = 1.0 terrain.chunk_size = 32 terrain.use_builtin_triplanar_material = true terrain.reset_flat_terrain() add_child(terrain) [/codeblock] For saved or shared terrain data, assign [member simple_terrain_data] to a [SimpleTerrainData] resource. For visual debugging in the editor, enable [member show_chunk_gizmos].

method.name: apply_brush
method.description: Applies a terrain brush at [param world_position]. The brush affects vertices inside [param radius] and rebuilds only touched chunks. This method is available at runtime, so gameplay code can modify terrain without using the editor toolbar.

method.name: apply_brush_with_delta
method.description: Applies a terrain brush like [method apply_brush] and returns compact undo data. The returned dictionary contains [code]indices[/code], [code]before[/code], and [code]after[/code] arrays for vertices that changed.

method.name: apply_height_patch
method.description: Applies explicit height values to the vertices listed in [param indices] and rebuilds only the affected chunks. This is primarily used by editor undo/redo to avoid storing or restoring the full height field after each brush stroke.

method.name: bake_navigation
method.description: Bakes the terrain height field into [member navigation_baked_mesh] using Godot's navigation mesh baker and switches [member navigation_build_mode] to [constant NAVIGATION_BUILD_BAKED]. This is intended as a manual step after terrain editing, not as an automatic brush-stroke update.

method.name: bake_dynamic_navigation
method.description: Bakes [member navigation_dynamic_baked_mesh] from the terrain, baked static obstacles, and runtime obstacle profiles from the current world placement data. The result is registered on [member navigation_dynamic_layers] when [member navigation_dynamic_enabled] is [code]true[/code]. Agents should query either the static layers or the dynamic layers, not both, when dynamic obstacles must block pathfinding.

method.name: clear_dynamic_navigation_blockers
method.description: Clears blockers registered through [method register_dynamic_navigation_blocker] and marks [member navigation_dynamic_baked_mesh] dirty.

method.name: generate_random_terrain
method.description: Generates a deterministic random height field using [member random_seed], [member random_frequency], [member random_octaves], and [member random_height_scale]. Use [method randomize_seed] when a new seed is desired.

method.name: get_brush_hit
method.description: Intersects a ray against the terrain surface. The returned dictionary contains [code]position[/code] and [code]distance[/code] when a hit is found. The ray is tested with a grid traversal algorithm instead of checking every terrain triangle.

method.name: get_chunk_debug_lines
method.description: Returns line segments that outline terrain chunk boundaries in local space. This is primarily used by the editor gizmo, but can also be consumed by custom debug drawing tools.

method.name: randomize_seed
method.description: Chooses a new random seed and calls [method generate_random_terrain].

method.name: register_dynamic_navigation_blocker
method.description: Registers an instanced [SimpleNavigationBlocker3D] so it is included by [method bake_dynamic_navigation]. Registration marks the dynamic navigation bake dirty but does not rebake immediately.

method.name: rebuild_mesh
method.description: Rebuilds all terrain chunk meshes from [member simple_terrain_data]. Call this after making many direct changes to [member SimpleTerrainData.height_data] if those changes did not go through [SimpleTerrain3D]'s setters.

method.name: rebuild_navigation
method.description: Rebuilds all terrain navigation meshes from [member simple_terrain_data]. Navigation meshes are generated per chunk and registered on the world's default 3D navigation map when [member navigation_enabled] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: reset_flat_terrain
method.description: Fills [member simple_terrain_data] using [member flat_height] and rebuilds the terrain. This is the default recommended initialization path for a blank editable terrain.

method.name: unregister_dynamic_navigation_blocker
method.description: Removes a blocker previously added with [method register_dynamic_navigation_blocker] and marks the dynamic navigation bake dirty.

members.member: World-space distance between neighboring terrain vertices. Increasing this makes the terrain cover more space without increasing vertex count.
Number of terrain quads per render chunk. Smaller values create more chunks, which can improve culling granularity but increase chunk management overhead.
Height used by [method reset_flat_terrain].
Number of terrain quads per axis. The terrain stores [member grid_size] + [code]1[/code] vertices per axis.
Convenience proxy to [member SimpleTerrainData.height_data]. Setting this property normalizes the array size and rebuilds terrain chunks.

Controls how generated terrain navigation polygons are emitted. [constant NAVIGATION_BUILD_TRIANGLES] preserves the legacy two-triangles-per-cell output, [constant NAVIGATION_BUILD_QUADS] emits planar terrain cells as quads, [constant NAVIGATION_BUILD_MERGED_RECTS] merges compatible cells into larger rectangular polygons inside each chunk, and [constant NAVIGATION_BUILD_BAKED] uses [member navigation_baked_mesh].
Navigation mesh resource produced by [method bake_navigation]. Assign a saved [NavigationMesh] resource here to keep baked navigation data outside the scene file, or leave it embedded in the scene.

Navigation mesh resource produced by [method bake_dynamic_navigation]. This mesh includes runtime obstacle profiles from the current world placement data and is intended for agents that need pathfinding to route around temporary world objects.
If [code]true[/code], [member navigation_dynamic_baked_mesh] is registered as an additional navigation region on [member navigation_dynamic_layers].

Navigation layers assigned to [member navigation_dynamic_baked_mesh]. Use a layer separate from [member navigation_layers] so agents can choose between static-only pathfinding and dynamic-obstacle pathfinding.

If [code]true[/code], SimpleTerrain3D can show its generated navigation debug overlay when Godot's global navigation debug display is enabled. Disable this to hide only the SimpleTerrain overlay while leaving navigation itself active.

If [code]true[/code], the SimpleTerrain3D navigation debug overlay also draws runtime avoidance obstacle footprints from world placement profiles whose navigation obstacle mode includes runtime avoidance.
If [code]true[/code], the terrain creates one [NavigationMesh] region per chunk and keeps those regions synchronized with terrain edits and node transforms.
Navigation layers assigned to generated terrain navigation regions.
Maximum terrain slope, in degrees, that is included in generated navigation meshes.
Maximum angle, in degrees, allowed between a terrain cell's two triangle normals before quad generation falls back to triangle polygons.
Maximum distance allowed between the fourth terrain cell vertex and the first triangle plane before quad generation falls back to triangle polygons.
Maximum normal angle difference, in degrees, between cells that can be merged by [constant NAVIGATION_BUILD_MERGED_RECTS].
Maximum height variation per merged rectangle step used to reject sharp discontinuities when [constant NAVIGATION_BUILD_MERGED_RECTS] is enabled.
Maximum distance allowed from merged rectangle corners to the seed cell plane when [constant NAVIGATION_BUILD_MERGED_RECTS] is enabled.
Maximum width or height, in terrain cells, of a single rectangle emitted by [constant NAVIGATION_BUILD_MERGED_RECTS].
Material applied to internal terrain chunks. If this is assigned, it takes precedence over [member use_builtin_triplanar_material] and [member GeometryInstance3D.material_override].
Normal-based blend sharpness used by the built-in triplanar material.
Height range used to blend between built-in triplanar material layers.
Color multiplier for the high height layer.
Height where the high layer starts to blend in.
Albedo texture for the high height layer.
Color multiplier for the low height layer.
Height where the low layer starts to blend into the middle layer.
Albedo texture for the low height layer.
Color multiplier for the middle height layer.
Albedo texture for the middle height layer.
World-space texture scale used by the built-in triplanar material. Higher values repeat textures more frequently.
If [code]true[/code], internal chunks use a generated height-based triplanar shader material unless [member terrain_material] is assigned.
Base frequency used by [method generate_random_terrain].
Height multiplier used by [method generate_random_terrain].
Number of noise octaves used by [method generate_random_terrain].
Seed used by [method generate_random_terrain].
If [code]true[/code], the editor gizmo draws chunk boundaries in the 3D viewport.
Resource containing the editable height field. Assign a saved [SimpleTerrainData] resource to reuse terrain across scenes or keep height data independent from the node.
Optional data resource containing world object placement records authored for this terrain. The initial editor UI can assign and edit this resource, but object generation is handled by later tooling.
Optional library of registered [SimpleWorldObjectProfile] resources available to world placement tools for this terrain.

signal.name: navigation_bake_finished
signal.description: Emitted after [method bake_navigation] finishes and [member navigation_baked_mesh] has been synchronized with the terrain navigation region.

signal.name: navigation_dynamic_bake_finished
signal.description: Emitted after [method bake_dynamic_navigation] finishes and [member navigation_dynamic_baked_mesh] has been synchronized with the dynamic navigation region.

constants.constant: Smooths terrain under the brush using neighboring heights.
Moves terrain under the brush toward the sampled center height.
Builds navigation meshes with two triangle polygons per walkable terrain cell. This matches the legacy SimpleTerrain3D behavior.
Builds one quad polygon per sufficiently planar walkable terrain cell, falling back to triangles for irregular cells.
Merges compatible walkable terrain cells into larger rectangular polygons within each chunk.
Uses [member navigation_baked_mesh], usually produced by manually calling [method bake_navigation] after terrain editing.
